question: What rules and numbers do the game-mode expression graphs hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/gamemodes.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Sabotage gadget: arming 30 s (needs on ground), interact fill 0.45 s, search range = `Sabotage_Distance` + 1 (+ `ImprovisorDistanceAdd` with the upgrade), applies the disable-all-vehicle-weapons effect for 29 s; blocked during the insertion sequence.
Sabotage projectile: the vehicle-sabotaged effect lasts 26 s; state steps at 28.7 s and at 6.5 s and 10.5 s after attach; immobilise duration = 26 - state 1 duration.
Capture rate (`TeamInsideVolume`): `CaptureSpeedMultipliers`[clamp(players, 0, 4)], x `fAssaultClassCaptureModifier` when the assault-class kill switch is on.
Battle royale loadout crate points: radius = zone radius x random^0.66, 20 tries per crate.

Battle royale airdrop placement: small-ring mode when ring radius < `BR_Airdrop_Small_Ring_Radius`; slope accepted below 0.1; a buffer ratio pulls the point toward the centre; reward-drop search constant 0.35.
Night Raid (single player) speed modifier: (0.715 + 0.285 x clamp((d - 2) / 13, 0, 1)) x 0.85, otherwise 0.87.
Contract counters (damage, headshot, kill, vehicle, capture, loot) are squad accumulators with thresholds passed in.
MCOM interaction graphs hold 60 and 4 constants (read as seconds; role inferred).

inference: Sabotage state meanings are inferred from the effects each state applies.
Integer compares `bb9ecb3e` and `7072f0cc` are not told apart between greater and greater-or-equal.
unresolved: Channel identifiers and native call argument records are hashed, so spot payloads and many channel reads are not decoded.
Deploy leader and squad tether logic is read only structurally.
Some data slots are written at run time and are variables, not constants.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Game-mode graphs read: mostly plumbing with few numbers; the sabotage gadget arms in 30 s and disables vehicle weapons for 29 s, its projectile effect lasts 26 s, capture rate is a multiplier table indexed by players inside (0 to 4), and battle royale loadout crates are placed at zone radius x random^0.66
leads.summary: All 114 game-mode listings were read (development autotests and single-player wrappers skimmed). Most forward to native code or read imported tunables. Solid rules: the sabotage gadget (30 s arming, 0.45 s interact fill, 29 s weapon disable; projectile effect 26 s), capture rate as `CaptureSpeedMultipliers`[players inside, 0 to 4], battle royale airdrop and loadout crate placement, and the Night Raid speed modifier. 13 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: A game-mode rule is needed for a claim, or the capture multiplier table values are joined.
